verdict: Ads rebounded strongly this week; several planned deliverables need catching up.
narrative: The last 28 days closed at a 4.46x return on ad spend against $1,460 in Meta investment, and the most recent 7-day window showed a meaningful acceleration — purchases up 120% and return on ad spend nearly doubling week-over-week. That rebound is real, though it is currently driven by a smaller number of higher-value orders rather than consistent purchase volume, so we are watching it closely rather than calling it a full trend shift. On the organic side, your Google Business Profile actions fell sharply in the most recent week, and we are investigating whether that reflects a drop in profile visibility or a data reporting gap. A set of planned funnel and content milestones that were scheduled between August and September are overdue, and we are actively working to close those out — completing them is the most direct way to support sustained performance heading into the next phase.

highlights.phrase: return on ad spend across the last 28 days of Meta activity
week-over-week increase in purchases in the most recent 7 days
Google Business Profile actions (calls, directions, website clicks) this period

watch_item.issue: Google Business Profile actions dropped nearly 40% week-over-week, with the last two days in the period showing no recorded activity — organic visibility may be softening.
watch_item.fix: We are auditing the profile now to determine whether this is a visibility issue or a data feed gap, and will have a clear answer before next week's report.
